strength_text: Beats simple greedy and corner-heuristic bots about 80–86% of the time; scores about one third against the Edax engine at level 1 (32–1–67 in 100 games).
eval_md: Agreement with the engine's move on 10,570 held-out Egaroucid games (legal moves only): 50.1% overall (moves 1–15 43.4%, 16–30 38.6%, 31–45 39.6%, 46+ 61.2%).
